BASE:T25.covered: Fresh init_db in two new processes creates no operational Sprint SQL objects or Card sprint_id; seeded permission presets contain no retired leaves and remain identical on second startup. Current ORM metadata/mappers/FKs and migration ledger exclude retired schema writers.

BASE:T26.covered: Frozen real v0.3.4 schema extended only in disposable copy with active/closed/cancelled/empty Sprints. Physical cut preserves all original Card/Spec/Ideation/Refinement cells except explicit Sprint detach/policy compatibility fields; bootstrap/cold replay preserves the remaining cells and canonical Card order. Original archive preserves exact Q&A/evaluation strings, authors and empty populations.

BASE:T27.covered: Same-Spec Cards retain distinct 90/60 confidence, false required and zero drift overrides, with spec-inherited completeness and source provenance. Equal inherited values do not create compatibility overrides. Frozen predecessor schema, unlinked Cards, replay and policy-race rollback covered.

BASE:T28.covered: Retired-only grants on direct and preset layers leave agent identity/credential/lifecycle fields unchanged and no current operational permission allowed. Cleanup preserves malformed/review classifications and prior effective authority without exposing credential material in migration evidence.

BASE:T29.covered: Archive, policy, permission documents, data journal and schema-cut cold replays retain exact prior receipts and database dumps; no repeated effects in these stages.
BASE:T29.remaining: End-to-end replay through final graph reconciliation/activation with the installed candidate pair remains unverified by this campaign. Stage idempotency is not final migration readiness.

BASE:T30.covered: Interruption after committed data steps resumes from retained proof, checkpoint/data writes rollback together, physical DDL failure restores rows, and fresh-process runtime admission rejects incomplete/lost/forged cutover evidence. Joint relational/storage restoration is exercised.
BASE:T30.remaining: Current installed predecessor/candidate paired-runtime rollback with native graph history and final activation must be rerun as delivery evidence. Synthetic build identifiers in adapter tests are not a paired-runtime rollback certificate.

Existing pagination migration resolves colliding positions by archived/position/id DESC; final oracle preserves canonical order and every other original cell. Physical-cut oracle still compares positions exactly. Original failed log retained.
